result.rationale: The diff changes Topic#expandable_first_post? from requiring `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. With hosts now stored in the embeddable_hosts table (and no presence check against that table), existing topics with topic_embeds stay expandable even after an admin deletes every allowed host, which the old check explicitly prevented. This is a verifiable behavior regression (or at minimum a substantive security/behavioral consequence) introduced by the diff.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in app/models/topic.rb, the `expandable_first_post?` method was changed from checking `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to just `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. This removes the check for whether any embeddable hosts exist. The finding correctly identifies that this means existing embedded topics will show as expandable whenever `embed_truncate` is enabled, even if all embedding hosts have been removed from the new EmbeddableHost table. This is a behavioral change that could be unintended - the original code required embeddable_hosts to be configured, but the new code doesn't check if any EmbeddableHost records exist.
